name: Titus
description: Tested leaders · household care · grace · good work · shared support
limits: Paul is the named letter speaker. Historical authorship, dates, Greek forms, manuscripts, ethnic generalizations, and a complete travel harmony were not independently verified. The quoted insult is not independent evidence for every Cretan. Nicopolis is not assigned a secure location.
review: All 46 verses read for three original contextual explanations and exact selections. Five selected profiles and one island reference do not claim exhaustive coverage. Church coverage follows actual discussion. Pietz's reading remains attributed. NET locality and coordinates support Crete without an exact town. No independent ethnic character claim or secure Nicopolis identification is made.

people.name: Paul
people.role: Named letter speaker who directs Titus to complete work on Crete
people.relations: He calls Titus a true child in their common faith.
people.meaning: His instructions connect sound teaching with tested care and work that meets needs.

people.name: Jesus Christ
people.role: Savior whose grace and self-giving ground the call to good work
people.relations: The letter connects his past gift and promised appearing with present conduct.
people.meaning: His work makes good deeds a response to grace rather than its purchase price.

people.name: Titus
people.role: Addressed worker charged with appointing elders and teaching conduct that fits sound doctrine
people.relations: Paul asks him to continue work on Crete and later come to Nicopolis.
people.meaning: His task connects tested leaders, household instruction, and support for traveling workers.

people.name: Tychicus
people.role: Worker named as a possible replacement before Titus leaves for Nicopolis
people.relations: The speaker may send him or Artemas to Titus.
people.meaning: The alternative sending keeps care for the assembly within shared work.

people.name: Apollos
people.role: Traveling worker whom Titus must help continue his journey
people.relations: The speaker asks that he and Zenas lack nothing for their journey.
people.meaning: His need makes the call to useful work concrete through material support.

places.name: Crete
places.summary: Crete is the island where Titus remains to complete work and appoint elders.
places.limits: Island reference rather than an exact town or meeting house.
